description: Reg. § 1.1411-5(b)(2)(i): income recharacterized as nonpassive under § 1.469-2T(f)(2) is not from a passive trade or business. Single, wages $250,000; one significant participation activity with $40,000 of net income (all recharacterized, Pub. 925 Worksheet B) and a passive business with $10,000 of income: NII $10,000 → NIIT $380.
